review_method: All fourteen final rendered pages inspected individually by the coordinating assistant. Author metadata, immutable code/documentation links, metadata and related-systems tables, editable architecture, literal commands, all client outcomes, cost equation/table, supplementary/data citation, references and every page boundary checked. Two body overflows in the first layout were corrected through emergency line stretch and the entire final PDF was re-rendered. No clipped or overlapping content observed. A separate reviewing agent independently checked extracted text and word-count boundaries; this is internal AI-assisted QA, not external peer review or human author approval.
word_count_scope: pypdf 6.10.0 extract_text().split() per page: 4005 total. Exclude only 15 page-1 title/author/affiliation words before Abstract; 119 page-2 metadata-table words from Nr. Code metadata description up to but not including Table 1:; 314 page-13 reference-entry words after References, retaining the page number; and 38 page-14 reference-continuation words up to but not including Current executable software version. Total excluded 486. All captions (including metadata caption), nonmetadata tables, diagram labels, equation tokens, abstract, keywords, headings, footnotes, declarations, email, footers/page numbers and executable-version paragraph remain counted. Only permitted word-limit exclusions are used, not broader page-target exclusions.
